name: WeInc API
description:
REST API for WeInc, the AI website builder: manage clients, website projects, templates, plans, analytics, and webhooks programmatically.

Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer wk_...` (self-serve API key from https://my.we.inc/agency/api on the free plan).
Rate limit: 100 requests per minute per credential. Every response carries `RateLimit-Policy`, `RateLimit`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 carries `Retry-After`.
Versioning: the version is in the URL path (/api/v1). Breaking changes ship in a new path version; a retiring version sends `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers at least 12 months ahead. Policy: https://my.we.inc/developers/versioning
MCP server (Streamable HTTP) for AI agents: https://my.we.inc/api/mcp, manifest at https://my.we.inc/.well-known/mcp.
